core_obligations: Restriction recovers F: (j_!F)|_X = F by the jshriek-open lemma, so the displayed arrow is the injective map H^0_c(X, G|_X) -> H^0_c(\overline{X}, G) of the covariance remark for G = j_!F (proof lines 617-622).
Reduction: the explicit nature of that map reduces the claim to: if s in H^0(\overline{X}, G) is a section, then the support of s is contained in the open X (proof lines 622-625).
Support containment: immediate from the vanishing of the stalks of G = j_!F at geometric points of \overline{X} \setminus X (proof lines 625-627).
